subject: ophthalmology
title: Strabismus, amblyopia and nystagmus

steps.tx: **Comitant squint** keeps deviation equal in all gazes: infantile esotropia (large angle before 6 months with cross fixation, DVD and latent nystagmus, needing early surgery with glasses) versus **accommodative esotropia** (hypermetropic toddlers over converging, fully refractive with full hypermetropic glasses, partly accommodative with residual needing surgery). **Intermittent exotropia** (bright sunlight closure, better control near) observes then operates for deteriorating control. Cover tests (cover uncover for manifest, alternate for latent with prisms measuring) quantify; Hirschberg estimates crudely.
steps.say: Cross eyed toddler needing full plus glasses: accommodative, spectacles first. Equal angle everywhere is comitant.

steps.tx: **Paralytic squint** varies with gaze (maximal toward palsied muscle) with diplopia and compensatory head posture: sixth nerve (esotropia worse on abduction, face turn toward palsy), fourth nerve (hypertropia worse on downgaze and head tilt to opposite side, Parks Bielschowsky 3 step test), third nerve (exotropia with hypotropia, ptosis, pupil rules). **Parks 3 step** (hypertropic eye, worse on contralateral gaze, worse on ipsilateral tilt) isolates superior oblique palsy. Thyroid and myasthenia mimic with fatigability and lid signs.
steps.say: Double worst looking at weak muscle is paralytic. Three steps point to fourth nerve: high eye, worse opposite gaze, worse same tilt.

steps.tx: **Amblyopia** (lazy eye) dulls vision in childhood critical period (to about 7 to 8 years) from strabismus, anisometropia or deprivation (cataract, ptosis); crowding and neutral density defects mark. Treatment is glasses first, then **occlusion patching** of good eye (hours by age and depth) or atropine penalisation, with close follow up for reverse amblyopia. Deprivation operates urgently then patches aggressively. Adult discovery rarely recovers; screening (photoscreeners, red reflex) catches before school.
steps.say: Patch the good eye before age eight or lazy eye fixes forever. Glasses first, then patch.

steps.tx: **Nystagmus** oscillates: infantile idiopathic (conjugate horizontal, null point with head turn, no oscillopsia), latent (uncovered eye beats nasally), spasmus nutans (infantile triad with head nodding and torticollis, benign but imaging selected), vestibular (jerk with fast phase away from lesion, vertigo with nausea), gaze evoked (drugs, cerebellar), see saw (parasellar), and acquired pendular in MS. Electronystagmography separates while MRI hunts acquired causes; prisms and surgery shift null points. Downbeat points to craniocervical junction (Chiari), upbeat to cerebellar vermis.
steps.say: Dancing eyes from birth without dizziness is infantile. New dancing with vertigo images brain.
